title: WebGL - webglcontextlost event
product-requirement: Terminals MUST raise webglcontextlost event when freeing a WebGL context
specification: Terminals MUST raise the webglcontextlost event when freeing a context (e.g., when application goes to background)
assertion: The webglcontextlost event fires when the WebGL context is lost

changelog.summary: Initial creation of webglcontextlost event test
